name: Skill Request Law (Part 2) (Testing)
description:
This allow works with the Skill Request Law (Part 1). What this law does is display the request for all requests on skill scrolls in the last 24 hours if they were given via the Part 1 law. The MoE and Research Assistant has access to these commands.All skills were broken into 4 skills to cut down on the number of calls to the DB done at once.

Commands;
!request review1 - Shows Carpentry, Shipwright, Composities, PaperMilling, Advanced Baking, and Advanced Cooking
!request review2 - Shows Baking, Cooking, Basic Engineering, Electronics, Industry, and Mechanics
!request review3 - Shows Farming, Fertilizer, Milling, Butchery, Masonry, and Pottery
!request review4 - Shows Advanced Masonry, Glassworking, Oil Drilling, Blacksmith, Smelting, Advanced Smelting, Tailoring, and Painting

Author: Kyokes

properties.Title: Skill Request Review 1 Command
properties.UserDescription: This command shows the requests made for Carpentry, Shipwright, Composities, PaperMilling, Advanced Baking, and Advanced Cooking in the last 24 hours.
